description: This file implements a ParallelPipeline class in Python, which manages concurrent processing of frames through multiple sub-pipelines, including lifecycle and frame flow coordination.

classes.name: ParallelPipeline
classes.description: A class that manages concurrent execution of multiple processing pipelines, coordinating frame flow and lifecycle events.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args)
methods.description: Initializes the ParallelPipeline with a list of sub-pipelines, each with its source and sink for frame management.

methods.name: processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-pipelines contained within this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: List["FrameProcessor"] entry_processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of entry processors, which are the sub-pipelines in this context.

methods.name: List[FrameProcessor] processors_with_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects and returns all processors within the sub-pipelines that support metrics collection.

methods.name: setup(self, setup: FrameProcessorSetup)
methods.description: Configures the parallel pipeline and all its sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the parallel pipeline and all its sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames by distributing them to all sub-pipelines, with synchronization for lifecycle frames.

methods.name: _parallel_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the main pipeline while avoiding duplicate frames based on frame ID.

methods.name: _pipeline_sink_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles frame pushing from sub-pipelines to ensure synchronized frame completion.
